title: Cisco security advisory (AV26-1175)
description: As of November 18, 2026, Cisco is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products:
products:
Secure Endpoint Connector for Linux
	Prior to 1.29.3

Secure Endpoint Connector for Mac
	Prior to 1.27.5

Secure Endpoint Connector for Windows
	Prior to 8.6.4
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
